items.title: [Question] Viability of SeaweedFS as filer metadata store
items.body: I'm curious why an external database is required for filer metadata.  I see that this has, of course, been asked and answered before  on Slack.  However, while I saw explanations as to why a database would be useful, I couldn't find any clarity on why SeaweedFS itself is insufficient.  Redis is a key-value store.  SeaweedFS is a key-value store.  If Redis can be used as the database, why can't Seaweed be used as the database?

items.title: File locking support
items.body:
I've got a question about the weed filer. Is there any file locking support? I could not find anything about it.
Talking specifically about FUSE mounts here, but would also be interested in general (filer directly).
On the wiki page https://github.com/chrislusf/seaweedfs/wiki/FUSE-Mount, locking is not listed as a supported feature.
So: is it possible to lock files in any way in SeaweedFS? Can I maybe add a custom flag somewhere and check for it on my own?
Thank you!
